item.subject: maths
item.stem: Chirag must construct rectangle $ABCD$ with side $DC = 4\,\mathrm{cm}$ and diagonal $DB = 6.5\,\mathrm{cm}$. The diagram shows side $DC$ already drawn.

options.text: Draw the line through $C$ perpendicular to $DC$, then take $B$ as a point on that line that also lies on the circle centred at $D$ with radius $6.5\,\mathrm{cm}$.
Treat the already drawn side $DC$ itself as vertex $B$.
Locate $B$ by trial-and-error with a ruler only, with no perpendicular line and no circle of radius $6.5\,\mathrm{cm}$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
